sections.title: Agreement Overview
sections.content:
This Sign-Off spells out the policies and expectations of being on this team. Please read all of these in depth prior to signing off. The reason of these signing off is because of recent lack of interest volunteers have shown towards team projects. This will confirm your participation in the team. If you have any questions or objections to any of these documents, please contact @sunnybasin on discord or via his contact page (https://sunnybasin.pp.ua/contact) or @ragdulls on discord.  
 
  This document gives an overview of the following sectuions you are about to sign. 

 • Section A: Overview 
     This section gives a preview on the following documents one is about to sign.   
 • Section B: Agreement 
    This section underlines the Volunteer-Team Agreements in more depth, and the Contribution and Assignment Agreement. This section also provides the possible consequences of violating any section. 
 • Section C: Team Policies 
    This provides the policies and procedures of every volunteer on the team. This is the most important section. 
 • Section D: NDA  
 
    This section provides in depth expectations on what you can and cannot say about each project. NDA stands for 'Non-disclosure Agreement'. 
 
 Please do not disclose ANY personal information. Once finished signing, please contact either @sunnybasin or @ragdulls on discord.
